text:
I


I have already lost the name that called me,

its face rolls through me

like the sound of water in the night,

of water falling into water.

And it is his smile that is the last survivor,

not my memory.


II


The most beautiful one

in the night of those who leave,

oh desired one,

your not returning is endless,

you shadow until the day of days.

translation.title: Privilege
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the doubled water sound and the austere final address to absence.
